text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it can also be stressful. When you visit a new country, you experience different cultures, traditions, and ways of life. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, and it often helps you understand the place better. However, language barriers can make things difficult. You might not understand signs or menus, and speaking to local people can be a challenge. Despite these problems, travel creates unforgettable memories. You learn more about the world and about yourself. Every journey teaches you something new, and that is why many people love to travel.
